evidence_items.finding: business operates at full member capacity yet loses approximately $3,200 per month — the current revenue and cost structure is not viable even at maximum capacity
evidence_items.rationale: Loss at full capacity is the defining unit economics failure signal. Paraphrased from symptoms. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: owner has not paid himself a market-rate wage for 11 months, meaning the true cost of the business is understated in the current loss figure
evidence_items.rationale: Owner wage exclusion from cost model is a structural understatement of costs. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: fixed costs total $9,000 per month — rent $7,200 and equipment lease $1,800 — against total revenue from 80 members at $275 per month of $22,000
evidence_items.rationale: Fixed cost structure as a proportion of revenue at capacity demonstrates structural insufficiency. No must_identify terms.

evidence_items.finding: personal training studio; annual revenue $264K; 1 owner-operator; 80 active members at $275/month; fixed costs $9,000/month; variable costs $2,100/month; monthly loss $3,200; 12 prospective clients on waiting list
evidence_items.rationale: Structured summary from facts_known_to_owner. Full capacity loss documented. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): member satisfaction scores are high and a waiting list of 12 prospective clients exists
evidence_items.rationale: High satisfaction and demand are misleading signals — they do not indicate that the current model is economically viable.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): three members have referred friends recently and the owner has received compliments on session quality
evidence_items.rationale: Referral activity and compliments are misleading positive signals that do not address the structural cost-revenue gap.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: Monthly loss $3,200 on revenue $22,000 = -14.5% operating margin; marginPct proxy = -15 rounded

validation_notes: HOL-03-001 is a full-capacity loss unit economics case. All findings derived from input_packet. No must_identify vocabulary used. marginPct set to -15 from monthly loss at full capacity.
